{{Quote|Whoa! A million credits? Who is this Savage Opress?|The Weequay, after seeing [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress's]] bounty|<ref name="Revenge (episode)">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''[[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]''' was active in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was present along with another [[Unidentified Balnab bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], a fellow [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], and two [[Human/Legends|Humans]], also bounty hunters, in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were scrolling through a list of the latest bounties when they came across the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and decided to take him, since he was worth the most credits. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] stepped in, however; and said that this one was for her.

==Personality and traits==
This Weequay wore goggles and protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]].
